seo.title: Rotimatic Case Study — Ascendrow
seo.description: A roti-making machine grows into an essential kitchen appliance.

aboutProject.title: About the project
aboutProject.highlightText: Rotimatic is an innovative kitchen appliance that fully automates the process of making fresh flatbreads.
aboutProject.bodyText: The machine takes away the hassle of measuring, kneading, and cooking. By simply adding flour, water, and oil, users can enjoy warm, fresh rotis in minutes. We partnered with them to scale their global sales pipeline, handling objections and closing deals with high-consideration buyers.

value.content: By integrating directly as an extension of the team, we completely transformed the sales pipeline. From automating support to closing high-consideration buyers across global markets, here is the tangible revenue we drove.

rightTimeline.title: $165K
rightTimeline.subtitle: Revenue Generated
rightTimeline.descriptionHtml: Influenced 110+ purchases of a ₹1.45 lakh ($1,499) premium appliance in about a month through live chat across global markets, generating ~₹1.59 crore before the product went out of stock.

rightTimeline.title: $60K
rightTimeline.subtitle: Closed Revenue
rightTimeline.descriptionHtml: Closed 40+ machines (~₹58 lakh) by positioning direct discounts at the exact right point in the buying conversation, converting high-consideration buyers without pressuring them.

rightTimeline.title: $450K
rightTimeline.subtitle: Pipeline Managed
rightTimeline.descriptionHtml: Worked 300+ opportunities worth ~₹4.34 crore in pipeline through consultative abandoned-cart recovery and objection handling, addressing price and product doubts directly.

rightTimeline.title: CRM
rightTimeline.subtitle: Automation
rightTimeline.descriptionHtml: HubSpot CRM: Owned the sales inbox and ticket queue end to end. Built automated email sequences and canned chat replies, kept response times low at high daily volume, and helped train an AI chat assistant that cut manual load on repeat queries.
